en: Black-and-white postcard view over a coastal fjord landscape with wooded hills on both sides and water extending into the distance. In the foreground there is a small town with houses and larger buildings among trees, and a ship or ferry visible on the water. The caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small oval publisher logo with a number is at the bottom right.
